panel.finding_key: packages/documentation/sheets/datasources.md::new datasources doc states a security model the code does not enforce: collaborators do execute queries with the creator's stored credentials
panel.summary: New datasources doc states a security model the code does not enforce: collaborators DO execute queries with the creator's stored credentials
panel.evidence: datasources.md says "The connection belongs to the person who created it. Collaborators can see the query and its last results, but run their own connection to execute it." The backend contradicts this: `POST /datasources/:id/query` gates only on `assertMember(ds.workspaceId, userId)` (packages/backend/src/datasource/datasource.controller.ts:139-144) and then runs the query with the stored, server-decrypted password of the creator (datasource.service.ts:133-152, 203). Any workspace member — including a low-privilege invitee — can run arbitrary SELECTs (and, with the validator bypass above, writes) against the creator's production database. Publishing the opposite as documented behaviour leads self-hosters to store privileged credentials under a false isolation assumption.
